title: τ³-bench
domain: Customer service with domain tools and a simulated user: airline, retail, telecom, banking.
good_to_know: Scores depend on the simulated user's and the evaluator's models: keep both fixed when comparing.
Conversations run in the upstream's own runner, release v1.0.1, at its defaults: 200 steps, 10 tool errors, seed 300.
Original is the upstream's own agent with your model, as in a leaderboard submission.
Several attempts per task report pass^k, as the leaderboard's 4 trials do. Each attempt is a new conversation.
A task whose retries all fail is an infrastructure error, not a score.
A tool call after the conversation has ended returns an error. An agent that keeps calling until its time runs out is not scored.
upstream_limitations: The agent must answer the user through the user tool, or the episode ends early.
Tool calls must be one at a time: the evaluator refuses concurrent ones.
limitations: banking_knowledge's search method is an option, bm25 by default. Scores compare only between runs with the same search. Reranker methods use gpt-5.2 through the relay. The qwen methods are not offered.
Another agent replaces the upstream's agent. It gets the upstream's instructions and policy, plus two lines from Nullius: where its tools are, and that its last message in a turn goes to the user.

datasets.title: τ³-bench
datasets.verifier: τ²'s evaluator: the database state and the conversation's assertions.
